detail: Corrected 02E repeated-seed classifier result was explicitly resolved.
Recovered 120 primary metric values; expected 120 = 10 seeds × 2 conditions × 6 metrics.
Each primary metric comparison contains exactly 10 one-to-one paired seeds.
Primary statistics are restricted to the selected 02E classifier table.
Fairness pairing is grouped by sensitive attribute, comparison identifiers, metric, and seed.
Only mean, SD, median, minimum, and maximum are reported.
No p-value or inferential significance test is produced.
Repeated holdouts reuse the same 193 participants and are not independent datasets.
